entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.

I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. It won't sync with my phone at all. I've tried everything. The thing is basically broken. So, can I return it or not?
Okay, thank you for clarifying. It sounds like you may have a defective unit, and I apologize for that experience. Let me just pull up your account and our return eligibility for you. One moment.
Look, I don't have time for a long process. I just need a yes or no.

I understand completely. And I see you're a VIP member with us, so I want to make this as fast as possible for you. Okay... I see your VeloBand was delivered 31 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy...
Yes, it looks like you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you right now. My apologies again that the band was defective.
Great. Finally. What's the next step?

I have just initiated the return in our system. Because of the trouble and your VIP status, I've gone ahead and selected expedited return shipping. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
